title: Claude Code plugin, layer 1
description: A Claude Code plugin (catalog kind plugin): .claude-plugin/plugin.json is the native manifest, with the safe-subset rules and the MCP carve-out. Labeled Claude Code plugin in the UI. When an mcpServers command is npx or uvx, an external_code entry for that server is REQUIRED (L1-8; a cross-field rule the pipeline enforces at gate 7, because a schema cannot read plugin.json).
